Head_and_Face: Head broader than pronotum with large prominent compound eyes.
Long sickle-shaped mandibles adapted for capturing prey.
Filiform antennae extending beyond midbody.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated body measuring 10-20 mm.
Bright metallic coloration in green, bronze, or copper tones.
Distinctive pale markings on smooth iridescent elytra.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six slender cursorial legs enabling rapid pursuit.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (head, thorax, abdomen).

Head_and_Face: Head small and partially concealed beneath pronotum.
Short clubbed antennae.
Body_and_Plumage: Small hemispherical dome-shaped body measuring 4-8 mm.
Elytra brightly colored in red, orange, or yellow with distinctive black spots.
Ventral surface black with membranous hind wings beneath elytra.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six compact dark legs.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body plan.

Head_and_Face: Prognathous head with prominent sickle-shaped mandibles.
Filiform slender antennae.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated flattened body measuring 5-30 mm.
Shining black or metallic integument with blue, green, or bronze iridescence.
Striated elytra with longitudinal grooves.
Cordate thorax with distinct lateral margins.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six long cursorial legs adapted for rapid terrestrial locomotion.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (three tagmata).

Head_and_Face: Robust toothed mandibles.
Extremely long segmented filiform antennae often exceeding body length.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated cylindrical body measuring 10-60 mm.
Body typically brown, black, or gray with mottled or banded patterns on elytra.
Hardened elytra with variable patterning.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six long legs with tarsal claws for gripping bark.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body plan.

Head_and_Face: Head small and partially retracted into pronotum.
Filiform antennae approximately half body length.
Body_and_Plumage: Oval to elongate body measuring 2-12 mm.
Elytra vividly patterned in metallic green, blue, yellow, or red with distinctive markings.
Smooth and glossy body surface.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six short stout legs adapted for clinging to foliage.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (three tagmata).

Head_and_Face: Broad head with clypeus modified into shovel-like structure for digging.
Body_and_Plumage: Robust stout convex body measuring 15-40 mm.
Dark brown to black integument with matte or slightly glossy finish.
Smooth elytra covering membranous hind wings.
Heavily sclerotized compact body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Broad dentate forelegs (protibiae) for excavation.
Specialized hind leg morphology for rolling dung balls.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body plan.

Head_and_Face: Males possess prominent cephalic horn projecting forward.
Often thoracic horn curving upward used in male-male combat.
Females lack horns (sexual dimorphism).
Body_and_Plumage: Large robust body measuring 30-150 mm.
Dark brown to black glossy integument.
Stout oval body in dorsal view.
Smooth elytra covering functional hind wings.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six long powerful legs with tibial spines for climbing.
Heavily sclerotized chitinous exoskeleton.

Head_and_Face: Distinctive elongated rostrum (snout) bearing chewing mouthparts at apex.
Elbowed (geniculate) antennae arising from rostrum.
Body_and_Plumage: Oval to pear-shaped body measuring 2-15 mm.
Hard integument in brown, black, or gray tones with mottled patterning.
Punctate or striated body surface.
Elytra often fused along suture.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six short stout legs.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body (three tagmata).

Head_and_Face: Head dominated by large compound eyes.
Mouthparts adapted for sponging, piercing, or siphoning.
Body_and_Plumage: Compact dipteran body measuring 2-15 mm.
Single pair of functional membranous wings with distinctive venation.
Hind wings reduced to halteres (knob-shaped balancing organs).
Integument variable from glossy black to metallic or patterned.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Six slender legs with pulvilli and empodia for adhesion.
Robust thorax with well-developed flight muscles.
Segmented flexible abdomen.

Head_and_Face: Head with large compound eyes and three ocelli.
Mouthparts modified into proboscis for nectar feeding.
Elbowed antennae with 12-13 segments.
Body_and_Plumage: Robust body measuring 3-25 mm with densely hairy surface.
Black and yellow or black and white banding patterns.
Two pairs of membranous wings coupled by hamuli.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Hind legs modified with pollen baskets (corbiculae) or scopae.
Stinger present in females.
Chitinous exoskeleton with segmented body.
